mapper.select: SELECT count(MSG_MST_NO) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SNDNG_TYPE_CD = '${msg_type}' AND MSG_STTS_CD = '00' AND (SNDNG_PRNMNT_YMD < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') OR (SNDNG_PRNMNT_YMD = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND GDBK_SNDNG_PRNMNT_TM <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24MISS')))

SELECT MSG_MST_NO AS MSGID, 'PH' AS MSGTYPE, CASE WHEN SNDNG_TYPE_CD = 'M1' THEN 'S' WHEN SNDNG_TYPE_CD = 'M2' THEN 'L' WHEN (SNDNG_TYPE_CD = '99' OR SNDNG_TYPE_CD = 'MM') AND LENGTHB(MSG_CN) <= 90 THEN 'S' WHEN (SNDNG_TYPE_CD = '99' OR SNDNG_TYPE_CD = 'MM') AND LENGTHB(MSG_CN) > 90 THEN 'L' ELSE 'L' END AS MSGKIND, MSG_CN AS MSG, MSG_CN AS MSGSMS, CASE WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 1, 4) IN ('0010','0070') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 2) WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 1, 4) IN ('0011','0019','0016','0017','0018') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 2, 3) || DECODE(SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 5, 1), '0', SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 6), SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 5)) WHEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 1, 3) IN ('011','019','016','017','018') THEN SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 1, 3) || DECODE(SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 4, 1), '0', SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 5), SUBSTR(TRIM(RCVR_TELNO), 4)) ELSE TRIM(RCVR_TELNO) END AS PHN, NVL(TRIM(SNDPTY_TELNO),'1355') AS SENDER, MOBL_BROF_CD AS PINVOICE, MSG_TTL AS MSGTITLE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGDT, CASE WHEN GDBK_TRSM_MTHD_CD = '01' THEN '00000000000000' WHEN GDBK_TRSM_MTHD_CD = '02' THEN SNDNG_PRNMNT_YMD || GDBK_SNDNG_PRNMNT_TM ELSE '00000000000000' END AS RESERVEDT, (SELECT MOBL_SYS_CD FROM MSB_LINK_SYS_E b WHERE b.MOBL_SYS_CD = a.MOBL_SYS_CD) AS SYSCD, CASE WHEN TO_DATE(SNDNG_PRNMNT_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '0' ELSE '1' END AS DATEFLAG FROM ${msg_table} a WHERE GROUP_NO = '${group_no}'
